attchmntText: NDL Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: NDL Ventures Limited published extracts of its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in The Financial Express and Mumbai Lakhwadeep on November 15, 2026. MVK Agro Food Limited published its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the same period in newspapers on November 14, 2026. The documents also contain public notices regarding property inheritance and legal claims. These notices invite objections from interested parties within fourteen days of publication regarding specific properties in Palghar, Thane, and Mumbai. The notices list legal heirs and claimants for various flats and shops. No corporate resolutions or shareholder approvals are mentioned in this filing.

attchmntText: NDL Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: NDL Ventures Limited submitted its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The results incorporate the merger of Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited into NDL Ventures Limited, sanctioned by the National Company Law Tribunal on November 03, 2026, and November 05, 2026. The submission was delayed by one day due to the receipt of NCLT orders and subsequent Diwali holidays. The financial statements have been subjected to a Limited Review by Statutory Auditors M/s. S. K. Patodia & Associates LLP. The company requests condonation of the one-day delay in submission.
